The final topic. When a regressor is correlated with the error term, no amount
of controlling will fix it — you need outside variation. This topic introduces
instrumental variables and two-stage least squares through the classic
returns-to-schooling problem.

downloadable bundle but have no rendered page here: their `modelsummary`

Open them in RStudio to work through them.
